title: Jeweled Indulgent Japanese Lemons Takikomi Gohan
description: An earthy and pillowy Japanese dish featuring lemons, infused oil, and no onion or garlic, perfect for a special occasion. This takikomi-gohan is a flavorful and indulgent meal.

ingredients.name: infused oil
ingredients.notes: such as yuzu or sesame oil

instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the water and combine the rice with 2 1/4 cups of fresh water in a medium saucepan.
Add the rehydrated shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, sake, mirin, and salt to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.
Simmer for 18 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is cooked.
While the rice is cooking, heat the infused oil in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the lemon wedges to the infused oil and cook for 5 minutes, or until they are slightly caramelized.
Once the rice is cooked, stir in the sesame seeds and cooked lemon wedges.
Serve the takikomi-gohan hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds and lemon wedges if desired.
